verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a first-party assistant, PlanetScale Bot, that helps users get started, understand performance, and fix slow or failing queries using PlanetScale's MCP server and skills. The doc path ('grok-bot') suggests it runs on an external platform rather than inside the PlanetScale dashboard. The self-improving-database flow relies on users' own external coding agents connected via MCP, so it earns no credit as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant is embedded in the PlanetScale console or dashboard, documentation of what tasks can be delegated and executed end-to-end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: PlanetScale Bot helps you get started with PlanetScale, understand database performance, and fix slow or failing queries using its [MCP server](/docs/mcp-server) and installed skills.
